name: AL PoC: Product Agent (resolve lines against catalog)

nodes.name: StartProductAgent
nodes.notes: Inputs: order_id, lines = [{line_no, product_text, product_code_hint, quantity, unit}]

parameters.text:
=Order {{ $json.order_id }}. Resolve each of these lines against the catalogue:
{{ JSON.stringify(($json.lines || []).map((l, i) => ({ line_no: l.line_no || i + 1, product_text: l.product_text, product_code_hint: l.product_code_hint || '', quantity: l.quantity, unit: l.unit || '' })), null, 2) }}

options.systemMessage: You are the Product Agent for Air Liquide packaged-gas order intake. For every order line you receive, find the single catalogue product it refers to, using only the tools. Rules: (1) If the customer gave a code, call lookup_product_by_code first. (2) Otherwise call search_product_by_name with two or three words taken from the customer's own line, in the customer's language (French, German or English): do not translate, the catalogue aliases are multilingual. A cylinder size alone (B50, B11) is not a product. Try at most three searches per line, then give up with not_found. (3) 'exact' means the customer wrote a code that matched a catalogue code (a cylinder size is not a code); 'resolved' means a search returned exactly one product whose name or alias describes the customer's line (same product family, not merely the same gas); 'ambiguous' means several plausible products and you must list them in candidates; 'not_found' means no tool result fits. (4) Never invent a product_code: product_code must be a value a tool returned, or an empty string. (5) Keep quantity and unit as given. Return the JSON the output format requires and nothing else.

nodes.name: ProductAgentModel
nodes.notes: Lab model. Customer instance: Gemini on Air Liquide's own API key or Vertex AI, by replacing this sub-node.

parameters.toolDescription: Look up one catalogue product by its product code. Use when the customer wrote a code such as ARCAL-1-B50 or OXY-IND-B50. Returns product_code, name, unit, category, is_cylinder, or no rows when the code does not exist.
parameters.query:
select product_code, name, unit, category, is_cylinder from al_poc.product_catalog
where upper(product_code) = upper($1) or upper(replace(product_code, '-', '')) = upper(replace($1, '-', ''));

options.queryReplacement: ={{ $fromAI('product_code', 'Product code exactly as the customer wrote it, e.g. ARCAL-1-B50', 'string') }}

parameters.toolDescription: Search the catalogue by product name or alias fragment. Use a short fragment: the gas or product name plus the cylinder size, e.g. 'arcal 1', 'oxygen B50', 'aligal 2'. Returns up to 10 rows with product_code, name, aliases, unit, category.
parameters.query:
with q as (select w from unnest(string_to_array(lower(translate($1, 'éèêëàâäôöûüç', 'eeeeaaaoouuc')), ' ')) w where length(w) >= 2)
select p.product_code, p.name, p.aliases, p.unit, p.category from al_poc.product_catalog p
where (select bool_and(lower(p.name) like '%' || w || '%' or exists (select 1 from unnest(p.aliases) a where lower(a) like '%' || w || '%')) from q)
order by p.product_code limit 10;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ $fromAI('search_term', 'Two or three words from the customer line, in the customer language, e.g. "arcal 1", "detendeur oxygene", "kohlensaeure b20". Every word must match, so drop quantities and filler words.', 'string') }}

nodes.name: ProductParserFixerModel
nodes.notes: Second model call only when the agent's JSON does not match the schema.

nodes.name: VerifyProductMatches

parameters.query:
select product_code, name, aliases, unit from al_poc.product_catalog
where product_code = any(string_to_array($1, ','));

nodes.notes: Deterministic check: every code the agent chose must exist in the catalogue. A hallucinated code is dropped.

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('StartProductAgent').first().json.order_id, $execution.id, 'product_agent', 'ProductAgent', 'Product Agent returned ' + ((($('ResolveProductsWithAgent').first().json.output || {}).lines || []).length) + ' lines', JSON.stringify({ output: $('ResolveProductsWithAgent').first().json.output, steps: ($('ResolveProductsWithAgent').first().json.intermediateSteps || []).map(s => ({ tool: s.action?.tool, input: s.action?.toolInput })) })] }}

parameters.content:
## 1. Product Agent

Called by the intake workflow with the order id and the extracted lines. The agent may only use the two catalogue tools and must return the structured shape; a hallucinated code cannot be returned because the parser schema and the verify step below both reject it.

## 2. Deterministic verify and log

Every code the agent chose is re-read from the catalogue. Lines are marked verified, ambiguous, not_found or unverified_code; quantities over 80 are flagged as Elephant Order. The tool calls are written to step_log as the agent's reflection trace.
